**Finding: NOSOLICIT — compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-poach or no-hire covenant binding AbbVie. Searches for "solicit", "recruit", "induce", "hire" and "employ or engage" returned nothing, and every "employee"/"personnel" hit was off-point (confidentiality, warranties, IP assignment, JGC attendance). The only two planner candidates were confirmed non-responsive: Section 6.15 (p0424) is a no-other-compensation/anti-bribery representation, and Section 2.2.2 (p0263) is a JGC meeting-attendance rule. Since the preferred position is that Customer bears no non-solicitation restriction, and that restriction is absent, no redline was proposed.
